metadata.scenario: A new customer is unhappy with the assembly service of their new furniture and requests rectification. Category: Service Complaint. Flags: quality_complaint.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I assist you today? Hi Margaret, this is William Chen. I recently had a knee surgery and started my care plan about three weeks ago. Hi William! It's great to hear from you. How has your recovery been going? Well, that's actually why I'm calling. I'm a bit frustrated with the last visit. I'm sorry to hear that. Can you tell me a bit more about your concerns? The physical therapy session felt rushed, and it didn't seem like the therapist was fully focused on me. I understand how important your recovery is, and I apologize for that experience. Which therapist was it? It was Dr. Rodriguez. I just expected a bit more attention, you know? I completely understand, and it's valid to expect quality care. I’ll make sure to address this with him directly. Thank you. I appreciate that. It’s just that I’m really eager to recover well. Of course, your recovery is our priority. Would you like me to schedule a follow-up session with Dr. Rodriguez? Yes, please. I think I need a more focused session to address my progress. Let me check his availability for you. Could you hold for just a moment? Sure, no problem. Thank you for your patience, William. Dr. Rodriguez is available on Wednesday at 10:00 AM. Does that work for you? Yes, that works perfectly. Great! I’ll set that up for you. Additionally, I wanted to mention that we also offer specialized pain management sessions. Pain management? Can you tell me more about that? Sure! We have sessions focused on managing post-surgical pain, which might help you feel more comfortable during recovery. That could be useful. How much do those sessions cost? They range from $95 to $125 for skilled nursing care. Would you like more information on that? I might consider it. I’ll think about it after the next PT session. That sounds good. I’ll follow up with you after your appointment to see how things are going. I appreciate that, Margaret. Thank you for your help today. You’re welcome, William! Thank you for bringing this to my attention. See you on Wednesday! Bye! Goodbye!
